data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display a date time form field with date or clock dialogs.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter widget that extends TextField to show a date or clock dialog when tapped. It supports multiple presentation types including date, time, combined datetime, and separated datetime fields, returning a formatted string via onChanged, validator, and onSaved callbacks.
use_when: You need a form field that opens a date or time picker dialog.
You want to present separate or combined date and time inputs in forms.
avoid_when: You are building a custom calendar UI rather than a form field.
You do not use standard text form fields for date input.
strengths: Supports multiple types (date, time, dateTime, dateTimeSeparated).
Integrates well with Flutter forms using validator and onSaved callbacks.
Allows custom date masks and selectable day predicates.
weaknesses: Only returns DateTime or Time strings, which may require manual parsing.
